players.product: E-Infrastructure site development (earthwork, grading, site utilities) and CEC electrical construction for hyperscale data-center and semiconductor campuses

quarterly_data.signal: Sterling's 10-K: the E-Infrastructure Solutions segment serves large end users in the data center, manufacturing, e-commerce distribution center, warehousing and power generation sectors; its top four customers accounted for 27% of the segment's revenue in 2025, 31% in 2024 and 40% in 2023. No individual customer accounted for more than 10% of consolidated revenues in 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: E-Infrastructure top four customers 27% of segment revenue (2025), 31% (2024), 40% (2023)
